rows.grounds: first member of compound describing number of arms
second member of bahuvrīhi compound catur-bbhujā; feminine nominative singular
first member of dvandva compound cara-acara denoting mobile beings
second member of dvandva compound cara-acara denoting immobile beings
epithet indicating indwelling presence in all that moves and does not move

items.question: What attributes and scope of indwelling characterize the goddess in this description?
premises: The goddess is described as four-armed.
The goddess is described as very fierce.
The goddess dwells in both moving and unmoving beings.
items.inference: The goddess combines a fierce, four-armed form with an all-pervading presence throughout the mobile and immobile world.
items.plain_english: She is four-armed and very fierce, and she dwells in all that moves and all that does not move.
